Also referred to as in-app messages, in-app notifications are messages that appear while a user is in your app. In-app notifications are available the form of full-screen pop-ups or small overlays, styled to suit your app’s interface . The content of these in-app notifications could include asking users to rate the app, asking users for push notification opt-ins, and more.

Users today have a tough time remembering what apps they even have on their device. Push notifications help these services deliver timely and relevant information to users, and in doing so, staying top of mind.

Notifications at their core are simply a way of alerting users to information that they have opted-in to from apps and services. Notifications encompass nearly every possible use case and sort of service, including other communications mediums like email, SMS, and VoIP.
And with such importance, we’ve to form these notifications much interactive and pleasant that user will never feel irritated and turn off notifications for your ecosystem that you designed.

The best way to design in-app notifications is through trial and error with A/B testing. That way, you’ll present the simplest , most engaging content to the large volume of users, having studied multiple variables like call-to-action text and promotion types.
